Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 82. Category: form. Royal Forms.

Power-Up
The user’s body turns black except for the area
around the mouth, center of the chest, hands, feet, and
knees.
Increase your Power by 4
You deal an additional 1d10 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 45 ft.
You gain an additional +3 to your AC
Costs 6 stamina to activate and you lose 5 stamina at
the end of each subsequent turn.
Black Frieza
